article.title: Official Liquidator to make payments into public account of India.
article.content: Every Official Liquidator shall, in such manner and at such times as may be prescribed, pay the monies received by him as Official Liquidator of any company, into the public account of India in the Reserve Bank of India.
article.html:
349Official Liquidator to make payments into public account of India.

Section 349 · Chapter XX · Part III · page 193 of the Act

Every Official Liquidator shall, in such manner and at such times as may be prescribed, pay the monies received by him as Official Liquidator of any company, into the public account of India in the Reserve Bank of India.
